verdict.rationale: Stripe docs say you can order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard. Readers can be registered by order or serial number right after unboxing, and no-code options (including Tap to Pay and the Dashboard mobile app) let you accept in-person payments without a custom integration. That covers the hardware-ordering and fast-setup parts of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence on the sign-up and account-approval process or its timeline, reader shipping and delivery times, and independent or hands-on confirmation that founders are actually live within the same week.
